definitions.explanation: A genre of Japanese young-adult fiction, typically published in paperback with anime-style illustrations. Abbreviation of ライトノベル.

examples.japanese: ラノベ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ラノベ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アニメ{化|か}→アニメ化：23065_animeka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This light novel was adapted into an anime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラノベ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{異世界|いせかい}→異世界：18438_isekai⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Recent light novels often feature isekai (other-world) settings.

notes:
ラノベ is a widely used abbreviation of ⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧ノベル (light novel). It refers to a genre of Japanese fiction aimed primarily at a young-adult audience, characterized by accessible prose and anime-style cover illustrations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラノベ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a light novel
- ラノベ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧: based on a light novel
- ラノベ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: light novel author

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧ノベル: full form
- ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧: manga
